name: ddd
description: Domain-driven design for the parts of a product that follow it: subdomains, bounded contexts and their map, event storming (events, commands, reactions, read models, external systems) and the tactical model (aggregates, entities, value objects, business rules, domain services), on the architecture pack so a context's deployed component and its framework's node are one node; oto ddd storm reads an event-storming board into a document and a capture the gates take, and a named person signs each element off with oto decide. The engine ships no ddd: this pack is it.
